title: Unsolved Problems in Combinatorial Games
notes: Records the open question: the misere quotient of ·07 has order 638 at heap size 33; is it infinite at heap size 34? Even if infinite, Redei's theorem says a finitely generated commutative monoid is finitely presented; the request is to exhibit D_34, D_35, and an algorithm deciding infiniteness. Distinguishes Dawson Chess ·137 from the two-digit cousin ·07. Historical miseregames.org Q33 page heading 'Complete Solution is Known' is a template artefact (blank period/preperiod) and is not a proof that the full quotient is finite.
